verdict.rationale: Babylon.js's docs claim TypeScript support with full IntelliSense, and its API is published as TypeDoc-generated typed class references (e.g., BABYLON.NullEngine). A community user also reports that the TypeScript integration works well, so typed API definitions an editor can attach to are clearly provided. missing for 10: explicit documentation of shipped .d.ts declarations and of diagnostics/navigation behavior beyond completions, and in-depth first-party tooling docs (the evidence is a one-line llms.txt claim).
